text: Chateau Lantern Hollow 2016, Pauillac. Cab Sauv dominant, some merlot. 94 pts. $142 at the estate shop. Cassis, graphite, cedar, pencil shavings. Decant 2h at least.
wed tasting - dom. Veilleux Chablis 1er cru Montmains '19 (chard obv.) ~91, EUR 38 ex-cellar. green apple, oyster shell, lemon pith, bit austere still
NV fizz from Halloran & Vane, English sparkling, Sussex?? chard/pinot I think. price tag torn off. 89. brioche, quince, v fine mousse
Barolo, Cantine Ostrava 2015, Serralunga. forgot to score it!! GBP 64. tar, roses, dried cherry, grippy tannins. nebbiolo obviously
Rioja Gran Reserva, Bodegas Alqueria del Sol, 2010... or 2011? label smudged. Tempranillo. 92-93 maybe. 28 eur. vanilla, leather, dried fig
house red at Luisa's place, no idea who made it. smoky, a bit rustic. 7/10 would drink again. $9 a glass
